title: New in Symfony 8.2: RateLimiter Improvements
content:
<html><head></head><body>The RateLimiter component controls how often an action can happen in your
application. Symfony 8.2 makes it possible to create limiters at runtime and
adds many features to the #[RateLimit] attribute introduced in Symfony 8.1.

Building Rate Limiters at Runtime…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
